generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Durable workflows fail when aggregate identity depends on a bounded recent-event page or command idempotency depends on state changed by the command itself.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: The happy path is correct, but enough child events make the root invisible and a retry after success derives a different idempotency key from the mutated state.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Persist and recover aggregate roots by stable identity independent of child-page bounds; key retryable decisions by a stable command identity independent of post-effect state.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Cross the implementation history boundary and rehydrate without reset; replay the same command identity sequentially and concurrently and require one effect, then use a distinct identity and require exactly one additional effect.

transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic long-history case preserves the original renewal root and distinct command identities.
Synthetic retry/concurrency case converges by decision identity while a new decision creates one new extension.
